mode: Read-only offline acquisition diagnostics; no production data writes, paid API/model calls, browser login or source enrollment.
method: Start from the fixed calendar/organizer roots. Breadth-first follow same-host event/calendar or ticket/workshop links, event-detail paths before calendar pagination, URL lexical ties. Parse Event JSON-LD and report visible event/date signals when no structured event is extractable. Record unsupported external event links as leads, never as acquired events. Reuse robots-aware public-URL checks. No search-result event names added.
eligibility: Parse explicit start/end, do not invent missing dates/end times. Require target-window overlap and explicit matching city/region evidence in the Event location, not a footer. Cancellation, access restrictions, missing location or timezone uncertainties are reported separately. Publicly accessible page is not public admission. Candidate facts remain review-required unless access, precise venue, source freshness and reuse are established.
pre_exposure: NYC sources are known development leads from earlier experiments; this is repeatability/yield, not blind discovery. Supplied Last Bite link is never a seed. No claim of metro recall.
decision: Report traversal coverage, extracted nodes, dated/in-region/review-required counts, blockers, requests/bytes/seconds and source-specific next decision. Zero events is a valid result. No broad crawler or adapter promoted solely from extraction yield.
